tasks.prompt: Show me all companies in our CRM

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: companies
- Filter: None (list all, limit 25)
- Fields needed: name (at minimum)
- Expected results: 25 company records with names

criteria: Returns company records (up to 25)
Response includes company names
Agent can list the companies from the response

tasks.prompt: Find all deals in the Nurture stage

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: deals
- Filter: stage equals "Nurture"
- Fields needed: name, stage
- Expected results: ~22 deals all with stage = Nurture

criteria: Returns only deals where stage is "Nurture" (not all deals)
Response includes deal names and stage values
Agent can answer "which deals are in Nurture?" from the response

tasks.prompt: Show me deals worth more than $50,000

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: deals
- Filter: deal value greater than 50000
- Fields needed: name, deal_value
- Expected results: 25+ deals all with value > $50K

criteria: Returns only deals where value exceeds $50,000 (not all deals)
Response includes deal names and values
Every returned deal has a value > $50,000

tasks.prompt: Find companies with 'Tech' in their name

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: companies
- Filter: company name contains "Tech"
- Fields needed: name
- Expected results: ~8 companies with "Tech" somewhere in their name

criteria: Returns only companies whose name contains "Tech" (not all companies)
Response includes company names
Every returned company has "Tech" in its name (not just in any field)

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: companies
- Filter: industry/category equals "Technology"
- Fields needed: name, industry/category
- Expected results: ~23 companies categorized as Technology

criteria: Returns only companies in the Technology category (not all companies)
Response includes company names and their category/industry
Agent can answer "which companies are in Technology?" from the response

tasks.prompt: Show me deals closing before March 2026

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: deals
- Filter: close date before 2026-03-01
- Fields needed: name, close_date, deal_value
- Expected results: 20+ deals with close dates before March 2026

criteria: Returns only deals with close date before March 2026 (not all deals)
Response includes deal names, close dates, and values
Every returned deal has a close date before 2026-03-01

tasks.prompt: Find Technology companies with more than 100 employees

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: companies
- Filter: industry/category equals "Technology" AND employee count greater than 100
- Fields needed: name, industry/category, employee_count
- Expected results: 10+ companies matching both conditions

criteria: Returns only companies that are BOTH in Technology AND have 100+ employees
Response includes company names, categories, and employee counts
No returned company is outside Technology or has fewer than 100 employees

context.expected_behavior:
- Object: deals
- Filter: None — sort by deal value descending, limit 1
- Fields needed: name, deal_value, associated company
- Expected results: Exactly 1 deal — the one with the highest value

criteria: Returns exactly 1 deal (not all deals sorted client-side)
The deal returned has the highest value in the workspace
Response includes deal name, value, and associated company
